notes: Lithuania 2026-11-05, second run (follow-up). Method: WebSearch with allowed_domains returned own-site URLs, which WebFetch then opened. Added 8 drambliai (6 sites; Pavilnys + Klaipėda 24 h), MAMBA VET Klaipėda (24/7), DR.VET Lazdynai Vilnius (00:00-23:59 daily), Šiauliai Veterinary Centre (24/7 line), Šnauceris Kaunas (on-call 24/7), plus non-24h clinics. Unreachable: mambaveterinaras.lt/kontaktai/ (client_error, main page worked), miskovetklinika.lt (robots_disallowed; search snippet suggests 'Skubi pagalba 24/7' - not used), zoovisata.lt/kontaktai.html (server_error; retry not allowed in-session), 1551.lt not used as source. Not covered: Panevėžys (no own-site page opened: jpvet.lt, doremiau.lt, Kristinos centras only found via search), Birštonas, Nida, Alytus 24 h (Vetaminas has none), Gedmino vet Šiauliai, Bravoveta Šilutė, LSMU sgk.lsmuni.lt. No national duty-rota page found (earlier VMVT/LVGA pages had none). No animal poison line: toksikologija.lt (Lithuanian Apheresis and Clinical Toxicology Association) has only articles, no helpline; 8drambliai emergency page lists no poison line.
